description: Do not let arbitrary carried junk become Mara evidence or award evidence trust; only existing field/museum evidence semantics qualify.

replacements.old:
<ROUTINE V-MARA-SHOW ()
    <MARA-ENSURE>
    <COND (<NOT <EQUAL? ,PRSI ,MARA>>
           <TELL "That person shows no interest in becoming part of this evidence record." CR>)
          (<NOT <HELD? ,PRSO>>
           <TELL "You need to be holding the object before Mara can examine it." CR>)
          (T
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-MET 1>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-LAST-EVIDENCE ,PRSO>
           <LC-NOTE-SHOW ,PRSO>
           <COND (<ZERO? <MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-EVIDENCE-SHARED>>
                  <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-EVIDENCE-SHARED 1>
                  <MARA-INCREASE ,MARA-SLOT-TRUST 3>)>
           <TELL "Mara takes enough time to examine the " D ,PRSO
                 ", then returns it to you. She remembers an actual object, not a gift transaction: it was ">
           <MUSEUM-PROVENANCE ,PRSO>
           <TELL "." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>
replacements.new:
<ROUTINE MARA-EVIDENCE-OBJECT? (OBJ)
    <COND (<OR <MUSEUM-ACCEPTS? ,MUSEUM-FRAME .OBJ>
               <MUSEUM-ACCEPTS? ,MUSEUM-WEAPON-WALL .OBJ>
               <MUSEUM-ACCEPTS? ,MUSEUM-RECORD-SHELF .OBJ>
               <MUSEUM-ACCEPTS? ,MUSEUM-RELIC-STAND .OBJ>
               <EQUAL? .OBJ ,DAM-SILVERFIN ,RESERVOIR-CHAR ,MARA-DAM-SURVEY-SHEET>>
           <RTRUE>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE V-MARA-SHOW ()
    <MARA-ENSURE>
    <COND (<NOT <EQUAL? ,PRSI ,MARA>>
           <TELL "That person shows no interest in becoming part of this evidence record." CR>)
          (<NOT <HELD? ,PRSO>>
           <TELL "You need to be holding the object before Mara can examine it." CR>)
          (<MARA-EVIDENCE-OBJECT? ,PRSO>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-MET 1>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-LAST-EVIDENCE ,PRSO>
           <LC-NOTE-SHOW ,PRSO>
           <COND (<ZERO? <MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-EVIDENCE-SHARED>>
                  <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-EVIDENCE-SHARED 1>
                  <MARA-INCREASE ,MARA-SLOT-TRUST 3>)>
           <TELL "Mara takes enough time to examine the " D ,PRSO
                 ", then returns it to you. She remembers an actual object, not a gift transaction: it was ">
           <MUSEUM-PROVENANCE ,PRSO>
           <TELL "." CR>)
          (T
           <TELL "Mara turns the " D ,PRSO " over once, then gives it back. Real object, yes, she says. Field evidence, no. Carrying something through the Empire does not make it part of the survey." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>
